Mina (PM): Quick sync — propose we ship GA with `relay` as default but add an optional egress-reservation feature: customers can reserve a small range of static egress IPs without full BGP peering. Need launch criteria, upgrade flow, and short field checklist by end of sprint.
Arjun (Eng): +1. Summary of modes: relay (low-touch proxy), reserved-egress (SNAT-like but tenant-isolated static IPs), and peered-preserve (full peering/BGP). Reserved-egress uses regional egress pools + per-tenant mapping; much lighter than BGP.
Yasmin (Solutions): Field feedback: enterprises want stable IPs for allowlists but hate peering complexity. Reserved-egress looks like a good compromise. Sales asks for a qualification rubric.
Leo (SRE): Ops notes: reserved-egress needs pool quotas, rotation policy, and alerts for pool exhaustion. Add SLIs: `egress_reserved_p95_ms`, `egress_pool_util_pct`. For peered-preserve we monitor `bgp_flaps/hr`.
Arjun (Eng): Rollout proposal: GA = relay + reserved-egress (feature-flag). Peered-preserve gated beta requiring operator >=1.3.0 and an operator-assisted runbook. Upgrade path when switching modes: preflight -> allocate shadow egress mapping -> 5-10m mirrored traffic validation -> cutover window -> rollback on health failure.
Mina (PM): Good. Can we publish minimal CLI snippets for docs?
Arjun (Eng): Relay (default):
```bash
./redwood-installer --network-mode=relay --region=us-east-1 --operator-version=1.2.0
```
Reserved egress preflight:
```bash
./redwood-installer --network-mode=reserved-egress --preflight --requested-ips=3
```
Peered preserve dry-run:
```bash
./redwood-installer --network-mode=preserve --preflight-only --reserved-cidrs=10.0.50.0/24
```
Yasmin (Solutions): I'll draft the qualification rubric: recommended mode by company size, NetOps readiness, and latency sensitivity. Also sample firewall allowlist text for reserved-egress and preserve.
Leo (SRE): Actionables on observability: add per-tenant dashboard tiles for `egress_tail_ms_p95` and `egress_pool_util_pct`, and set pager thresholds when pool_util >85%.
Mina (PM): Action items: 1) Arjun: spec reserved-egress allocation + upgrade flow (due 4 working days). 2) Yasmin: qualification rubric + firewall copy (due 2 working days). 3) Leo: SLIs/dashboards + alert playbook (due 6 working days). 4) I'll prepare GTM default language and decision table.
scheduler-bot: Reminder set: "priv-deploy-egress-review" on 2024-07-22 16:00 UTC.
Arjun (Eng): Note compatibility: preserve requires operator >=1.3.0; reserved-egress requires >=1.2.0; relay back to 1.0.x. Also add a console badge showing selected network mode with an admin-only toggle and explicit maintenance window confirmation for mode changes.
Mina (PM): Locking this thread as the decision snapshot. Will update after specs land. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
